To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel attention mechanism that aggregates information across multiple layers in a neural network, and demonstrate its effectiveness for various tasks in the domain of image restoration.

(1) Cross-Layer Attention can effectively capture long-range correlation among features at different layers; (2) Adaptive Cross-Layer attention can further improve the performance of Cross-Layer Attention by dynamically selecting the number of keys for each query; (3) The insert position of Adaptive Cross-Layer modules can be automatically searched by a neural architecture search method, and the searched model can achieve comparable performance with the manually designed one, but with much less parameters and FLOPs.
the proposed adaptive cross-layer attention module improves image restoration performance while keeping the network compact.
